title: This is fraud! Thieves!
body: They stole 40$ from my account, even though I didin’t have any subscription and never used the app. Just downloaded and deleted it, nothing more. Be careful, they steal money under the guise of mental health.
author: ZzzzzZzzzZzzz888889

title: Be careful - they trick You into purchase
body:
This should be illegal. They use lack of focus among the targeted ADHD group and trick You into in app purchase without confirming  payment! They use the account from 1 euro trial and small print the info about the purchase. Later - after claim - they do not want to return the money, as a policy.

Customer service is a joke, they know they are stealing and they just lie in Your face how returns are not possible. This app should be legally checked for scam.
author: Therapist-MD

title: Subscription
body: Oh my God! This app is taking money from your account for the subscription I didn’t wanted.
author: monichetta44

title: Złodzieje
body:
Raz ściągnęłam aplikacje żeby zobaczyc czy naprawdę pomoże mi z moim ADHD była, słaba, myślałam ze mam kilka dni za darmo, wiec zrezygnowałam. 
Po 3 miesiącach zobaczyłam ze z konta zniknęło  mi już 3 razy po 30 € 

Masakra, złodzieje nigdzie nie mam ich w subskrypcji, na żadnym koncie a pobierają mi kasę z konta, nie odpisują na maile ! 
Nie wiem czemu ta beznadziejna aplikacja jest w tym sklepie??? 
Czemu nikt ich nie wywali albo zgłosi ze okradają ludzi ???  
Przecież nie tylko ja jestem oszukana i nic z tym nie da się zrobić
author: Mushek00

title: SCAM
body:
Cancelled subscription early in the trial period and I was still being charged.
Upon reaching out they tell you to log in (in my case download) the app again to cancel my subscription (sic!).

body: the application took twice 30USD for subscription which costs 1 USD for 3 days from my card, they don't answear mails, no contact, they earn money from naive people 👎👎👎

title: Scam
body:
They tried to bill me additional 40 dollars for a purchase that I did not authorize. Also, the payment does not go through App Store, so you cannot cancel your subscription on the side or in the app.
 Truly, nothing more pathetic than masking a scam under something that is supposed to help people.

title: Scam
body: The app offers you purchase option without you knowing and it only takes one miss click to lose 30 USD. DO NOT DOWNLOAD!

title: Poor costumer service
body: I didn’t want to subscribe it I finished the subscription and they took money from my card. They are not answering for emails, facebooks acount or on any other way. I wanted the refund, because I’m not using this app, but they are not answering in any way. It’s a scam!
author: Feel scammed mb

title: Scam!
body: I never got access to app and I realized they charged me different amount (4 times bigger) than in my country. Second payment was took when I tried to cancel my subscription because obviously it also took a long time.

title: Scam, they are stealing money
body: There is no simple way to cancel your subscription. They will charge you 30 EUR every month without consequences. They are stealing money legally. Company is located in Cyprus with CEO that probably doesn’t exist. Do not agree for the trial period!
author: Alice9987

title: I didn’teven use
body: There’s no reminder and no subscription in App Store and it charged me 30€. I didn’t even activate and use this app. I hate this scam!

body: Pobierają środki mimo rezygnacji z subskrybcji!!! Aplikacja nie pojawia się w kupionych, a 30€ zniknęło z konta!!!!
author: Nela1900

title: It’s a scam
body:
There is no way in the app where you can cancel your subscription. You have to write an email and they don’t respond on time. 

They don't answer your emails on the pretext of a lot of work and despite writing to cancel your subscription the money is taken from your account. The worst 30€ spent in my life, I feel cheated.
author: Sylwester Z

title: This app is a scam!
body:
Avoid subscribing! I had to change my debit card.
There is no way to cancel subscription, there is no such button in the app (we’ll, it just does not work). And they ignore emails. 
Well, this is how some apps decide to make money🤷‍♀️

Nie pamiętam jak się logowałam, więc nie mogę wejść na swoje konto w aplikacji aby zrezygnować z subskrypcji. Gdy podaje maila Habio nie rozpoznaje użytkownika, a z konta kolejny raz ściągają mi 29.99€. 
Chce natychmiast zrezygnować z subskrypcji.

title: Avoid paid subscription
body:
I was tempted by a 3-day free trial. Did not like the app, as this is mostly about displaying content from the internet on “how to be happy” so cancelled the subscription the same day.
Yet still they charged me as there is a certain way you need to follow via the app and confirming through email.

body: Zapłaciłam około 5 zł za jakiś plan którego potem nawet nie mogłam zdobyć bo przy każdej próbie zalogowania wyskakiwał błąd. Wiec w konsekwencji nie użyłam tego planu, nie stworzyłam konta a dzisiaj, 3 dni po tym jak plan który zakupiłam się skończył, próbowali mi ściągnąć z konta 29,99 EURO! Nie ma o tym żadnej informacji w subskrypcjach w APPLE ID i nie ma żadnej informacji w mailu.

title: Warning! Few words about subscription.
body:

No info about auto subscription.
It’s fraud.
